caption:
Messi's playoffs start Saturday. 🏆

Inter Miami (No. 2 seed) host Columbus (No. 7) at Nu Stadium, Sat Nov 21 at 6 PM ET. Best of 3: Game 2 is Nov 27 in Columbus, and a Game 3, if needed, is back in Miami on Dec 1 or 2. It's the first time these two have ever met in the playoffs.

Messi just won his second straight Golden Boot with 26 goals, the first player to do it back to back, and he's staying in Miami through 2028.

Who wins the series? Comment below 👇
